digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler, Jira Data Center bridge, live integration
propositions: the reconciler must round-trip mutations in both directions (inbound DC-to-local, outbound local-to-DC) against a real Data Center instance using a scrubbed copy of the project's actual ticket store, not an empty one

isolation requires multiple independent layers: a separate git repo with no remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials, and removal of all .bridge_state* artifacts and jira key bindings from the copied store
a scrubbed store copy must have zero binding artifacts, zero prev_snapshot baseline files, and zero bridge state backups, verified by structural glob matching not hardcoded lists
every mutation in the comprehensive suite must be asserted individually with a named oracle (the exact path read back from the instance), not via aggregate convergence metrics
outbound mutations require a pre-established binding created by a filtered bootstrap pass, because an unbound ticket routes to CREATE not UPDATE and silently skips the test's intent
pagination must be proven with a measured server page size, seeds of 2*observed+1 issues forcing at least three pages, and full recovery count asserted from the plan not assumed from output
